scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:setup:local: bun run db:migrate:local && bun run db:seed:local
scripts.db:setup:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to="${E2E_PERSIST_PATH:-.wrangler/e2e-state-v2}" && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to="${E2E_PERSIST_PATH:-.wrangler/e2e-state-v2}" --file=./seed/local.sql
scripts.r2:lifecycle:setup: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add "${R2_BUCKET_NAME:-openworkspace}" openworkspace-composer-uploads composer-uploads/ --expire-days 7 --force
scripts.typecheck: bun run cf-typegen && tsc -b && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json

DB.description: D1 stores users, passkeys, sessions, mailbox permissions, and one-time access links.

MAILBOX.description: One SQLite-backed Durable Object per mailbox stores RFC metadata and conversation state.

MAIL_STORAGE.description: R2 stores raw MIME, HTML bodies, and attachments outside the relational hot path.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional. R2 S3 API access key for presigned attachment uploads. Create under R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional. R2 S3 API secret for presigned attachment uploads.

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional. Cloudflare account id used in `https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.

R2_BUCKET_NAME.description: Optional. R2 bucket name for presigned uploads (defaults to openworkspace).

IMAGES.description: Cloudflare Images stores profile avatars. Delivery URLs use imagedelivery.net with a public variant.

EMAIL.description: Email Service sends outbound mail. Onboard the sending domain after deployment.

OIDC_ISSUER.description: Optional. Canonical public HTTPS origin of this Worker (no trailing slash), e.g. `https://mail.example.com`. Set with `wrangler secret put OIDC_ISSUER` after deploy — do not use localhost.

OIDC_SIGNING_PRIVATE_JWK.description: Optional. RSA private JWK for the OIDC IdP. Generate with `bun run oidc:keygen`, then `wrangler secret put OIDC_SIGNING_PRIVATE_JWK`.
